summary: A user described a trading platform promoted through a coworker where a purported analyst directed fixed Ethereum futures trades and displayed rapid profits. The platform credited users with funds and allowed small withdrawals while encouraging participation in the purported trading system.
user_mistake: trusted platform credibility based on coworker results and displayed returns
prevention: Verify the trading platform and operator through independent regulatory sources before depositing / Treat guaranteed rapid returns and platform-funded balances as warning signs
